h: Updated Ballon d'Or rankings published days before London ceremony
p: Fresh rankings for the 2026 Ballon d'Or have reportedly been released just days ahead of the award ceremony in London. Football fans in Nigeria and beyond are debating who deserves the trophy.
more: The ceremony is due to take place in London early next week.
Several players are said to be in contention for the top prize.
alt: A Ballon d'Or trophy on display
